name: MTA subway merchandise
about: Souvenirs themed on the New York City subway system, run by the MTA. They are a fun nod to the city's most famous everyday transit.
tip: Look for small items here, since they are easy to carry home.

name: Black and white cookies
about: A classic New York deli and bakery treat with half chocolate and half vanilla icing. It is a long-standing part of the city's baking tradition.
tip: These have a short shelf life, so buy them just before you fly home.
